name: Mechanical Repair Kits
label: Quest
description: Mechanical Repair Kits: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The biggest reason I can't open up my booth is that... Everything's broken! I need mechanical repair kits to fix all this stuff!
Can you bring me those kits, friend? I'll trade you... Kits for Darkmoon Faire tickets. What do you say?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you! Now I can get to fixing things.

It's going to take a lot of repair kits and a lot of late nights to get everything in working order. Sometimes I think it'd be better to get back to my roots and restart my career as a headhunter, but... The Faire has been good to me.
Take these tickets, friend, and have fun!
